resolution.note: worker start refuses a repo with package.json and no node_modules/.bin (exit 64)

title: Worker start refuses a worktree without installed dependencies
body: Outcome: krn worker start exits 64 'dependencies missing: run pnpm install --frozen-lockfile in <repo>' before any state write or spawn when <repo>/package.json exists and <repo>/node_modules/.bin is absent. Evidence: PR #193 round 2 in a fresh worktree, tsc and biome checks exit 127 (.krn/runs/lead/verify-observer/rounds/002/report.json); the lead installed by hand. Proof: new observer under test/worker/ red at base by assertion.
